verdict.rationale: The skills are plain SKILL.md markdown files in a folder hierarchy (e.g. skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md), and the installer writes them into your repo as ordinary editable files you own. They are MIT-licensed and advertised as working with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. A Claude Code plugin route also exists as a managed read-only bundle, but it is an alternative to owning the files, not a proprietary format. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of carrying the files to a non-Claude harness, and explicit documentation of the folder layout and any harness-specific frontmatter beyond what the file paths imply.
